Quillfeather Australian Labradoodles

We are an ALAA Platinum Paw member breeder in Adderly, Massachusetts, and a WALA All Star breeder. Our program follows the ALAA breed standard.

We breed standard size Australian Labradoodles only. Our adults stand 21-23 inches at the wither and weigh 52-62 lbs.
